links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of fine-tuned GPT-3 versus board-certified pediatricians on same encounters
links.effect: GPT-3 accuracy 87.3% (131/150) vs pediatricians 91.3% (137/150); P=.47, comparable. Rare diagnoses 80% (16/20) vs 85% (17/20); P=.62.
links.quote: The GPT-3 model achieved an accuracy of 87.3% (131/150 cases), sensitivity of 85% (95% CI 82%-88%), and specificity of 90% (95% CI 87%-93%), comparable to pediatricians' accuracy of 91.3% (137/150 cases; P=.47).

links.outcome: Model accuracy across age subgroups and common complaints
links.effect: Accuracy consistent across age groups: 0-5 years 54/62 (87%), 6-12 years 47/53 (89%), 13-18 years 30/35 (86%); fever 36/39 (92%), abdominal pain 20/23 (87%).
links.quote: Performance was consistent across age groups (0-5 years: 54/62, 87%; 6-12 years: 47/53, 89%; 13-18 years: 30/35, 86%) and common complaints (fever: 36/39, 92%; abdominal pain: 20/23, 87%).

screen.reason: Retrospective cohort study evaluating the diagnostic accuracy of fine-tuned GPT-3 compared with pediatricians on retrospective encounter data.
